name: Shardling

unity.note: FBX: Blender -Y forward becomes Unity +Z. Positions below are in the model root's space, Unity axes.

clips.name: Idle
clips.note: Hover and kite. Face the player by turning the whole object.

clips.name: Charge
clips.note: Charging an orb (0.75 s). Fire the orb from the Eye socket at the end.

clips.name: Death
clips.note: Rings drop and the core winks out; the game shatters it.

notes: Pivot is the crystal centre: place it at ground + 2.4 m. States in types.js -> clips: idle=Idle, kite=Idle, charge=Charge (then spawn the orb at the Eye socket), Fire after shooting.
